title: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Liber II Cap. 4 densify complete)
author: Ludwig Crocius
edition: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Bremen: Berthold Villerian, 1636). VD17 14:684303C. SLUB id335860389. Liber II Cap. 4 De animae immortalitate e perspicuis scripturae testimoniis COMPLETE (mid PHYS 354-mid-356 before CAPUT QUINTUM).
blurb: Ludwig Crocius — Book II Chapter 4 On the immortality of the soul from clear testimonies of Scripture, from the 1636 Bremen Latin. Densify COMPLETE (mid PHYS 354–mid-356): Cap. 4 title; OT/NT testimonies; Ecclesiastes 12:7 (Augustine); Matthew 10:28; Lazarus; thief on the cross; Philippians 1:23; Stephen; Revelation 6:9 — Cap. 4 close. Cap. 5 starts mid PHYS 356 (De statu animae a corpore separata). Liber I Cap.1–11 and Liber II Cap.1–3 COMPLETE (english not modified).
